answer_sheet.Size and illustration style: Square, 640 by 640 pixels. Illustration style is your call.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a poster with a cream background. I'm in a bit of a slow-weekend mood, which is why this idea appeals to me. The poster should be square, with the dark brown headline 'SLOW SUNDAY' centred near the top. There should be a little illustrated coffee cup in the bottom half. Please leave plenty of space around the headline, and don't include any other words. I always end up over-explaining these things because I worry I'll forget to mention something.

style.prompt: Design a square minimalist illustrated poster with a warm cream background. The ONLY text is the exact headline 'SLOW SUNDAY' in dark brown, centered horizontally near the top, in tasteful bold clean typography. Keep generous margins and abundant empty cream space surrounding the headline. In the bottom half, place one small charming illustrated coffee cup, centered horizontally, simple hand-drawn flat illustration with dark brown outlines and muted warm tones. The coffee cup should be small relative to the canvas, leaving lots of negative space. Quiet, relaxed slow-weekend mood, refined editorial poster composition. No other words, no subtitle, no labels, no signature, no watermark, no border.
